data.name: Mahindokht
data.long_meaning: The name Mahindokht is of Persian origin, derived from the Persian words maḥ (moon) and hind (light). It symbolizes the moon's gentle and radiant light, which illuminates the night and inspires awe and wonder. In Islam, this name carries spiritual significance as a reminder of Allah's blessings and guidance.
